what: Stage 4 — Patch upstream for R hosting
title: zusmt roadmap
text: Maintain numbered patch series tools/patches/, applied vendor.sh, version bump re-applicable rather re-discovered. exit()/abort() → throw (ApiException/InternalException already exist upstream). std::cout/printf → Rprintf/REprintf, route output sink R layer controls. std::cerr diagnostics → REprintf. Long-running solves must remain interruptible: plan R_CheckUserInterrupt() via OpenSMT’s stop callback (GlobalStop), never longjmp C++ frames. title: zusmt roadmap
